m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You're back! But where's Dufresne? He tunneled out! I should have known he'd do something like that. What? He left me a note? Let me see it!
Hmm... I can't say I really understand what he's saying here, but I'm glad that he's free. Though I suppose I will miss him, sure enough.
I thank you most kindly for your help. Perhaps I'll see you again someday when I finally leave this place... whenever that may be.
Say, you don't righty belong in this prison, do you? Then again, I'd wager most people in here would answer no to that question.
Whatever it is you're up to, I want no part in it. I've no mind to cross the Empress and her thugs. I've made enough mistakes.
But my friend Dufresne is as innocent as a newborn. He's in solitary confinement in Cell Block B now on account of all his escape attempts.
I fear the isolation is dealing him a fate worse than death! If you're busting people out of here, could you please help Dufresne as well?
One of the Iron Paws here in the Yard should have the Cell Block B Key. Get it and go rescue Dufresne before it's too late!
Please get the Cell Block B Key from the Iron Paws so you can rescue my dear friend Dufresne from the horrors of solitary confinement!
